blocks.text: The movement gains practical form as routes are discussed, expenses shared, and some Sikhs travel disguised as banjaras in order to pass through dangerous ground unnoticed.
Others come by alternate routes through Malwa and the hills, showing how the growing force depends on improvisation as much as zeal.
By emphasizing banjaras, expenditure, and route choice, the page shows that Banda’s campaign is logistical as well as inspirational.
